links.description: Alleged to have facilitated political funding from Vusimuzi 'Cat' Matlala to Mchunu.
Close associate; identified Matlala as 'John Wick' in Crime Intelligence circles.

testimony_details.forum: Parliamentary Ad Hoc Committee on Police Infiltration
testimony_details.summary: Denied being a middleman for Mchunu; alleged that KZN Commissioner Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi had also met with Matlala.

controversy: Implicated in the funding of ANC events using money allegedly sourced from cartel-linked tenders.
